jei.simplegadgets.info.amethyst_lens: Hold right-click to show a dot where you aim, visible to nearby players; the rod tilts forward, sparks, and the crosshair makes way for the dot. Held on a block for a moment the beam melts ice and snow, lights campfires, candles and soul fire, dries wet sponges, sets flammable blocks alight and primes TNT (never nether portals); held on a creature it first scans it - it glows for 5 s - and then sets it on fire (twice as long; players only with PvP). The farther away, the longer it takes (3 s up to 5 blocks, about 20 s at 200 blocks). Every use costs charge (4 per second, a full rod lasts 160 s), even pointing into the air; an empty rod never breaks - recharge it in an anvil with amethyst shards, no levels needed (16 shards = full). With Constructor's Touch (book in an anvil) it also measures: distance, target block and height in the mod's HUD box, and it remembers the last measurement.
jei.simplegadgets.info.echo_sounder: Right-click a lodestone to link it (clicking the lodestone it is already linked to does nothing), then hold use for 3 seconds to teleport onto it - no ender pearl needed. Use it deliberately: linking and every attempt that does not jump (released early, lodestone missing or jump blocked) lock it for 1 to 5 seconds depending on how far the lodestone is, shown as the item cooldown; 24 s cooldown after a jump. One successful jump empties the echo sounder completely, even with Unbreaking: recharge all 1500 points with Mending XP or echo shards at an anvil before it works normally again. Used while not fully recharged it charges for 6 seconds with warning signs and shatters after the jump.
jei.simplegadgets.info.velocity_gauge: Held in either hand, the Gauge shows speed; in the air it also shows height above ground.
jei.simplegadgets.info.rotator: Turns orientable blocks where they stand: right-click the middle of a face to turn forward, sneak + right-click to turn back, click the rim of a face to align the block to that edge. With a block in the off hand a click swaps the two blocks. It also puts armor stands into poses. Every turn costs 1 of its 1024 charge; it never breaks - recharge it at an anvil with ender pearls.
tooltip.simplegadgets.magnet.clear.2: Sneak + right-click the air: clear filter.
tooltip.simplegadgets.detector.place_hin: Sneak + Use on a block: place.
Sneak + Use in the air: switch mode.
tooltip.simplegadgets.detector.damping: Rock damps the signal; dense rock more.
jei.simplegadgets.info.detector: Held in either hand, the Detector pings the nearest ore in reach: chimes, a particle beam and a needle that glows brighter the closer the ore is. Sneak + use in the air switches the mode (iron, gold, diamond, netherite, all ores, custom); sneak + use on a block calibrates it to that block. Rock damps the signal, dense rock more; Radius reaches further, Constructor's Touch halves the damping. Each ping that finds something costs 1 durability. With SimpleBuilding a calibrated Detector can be laid down (sneak + use on a block) and keeps searching there.
jei.simplegadgets.info.magnet: Held in either hand, the Attractor pulls loose items towards you (4 blocks, +2 per Range level, at most 9); sneaking pauses it. It leaves display items, items reserved for others and other players' death drops alone. With Constructor's Touch it can filter: sneak + right-click an item or block (or right-click an item in the inventory or a framed item) to pull only that item; sneak + right-click the air clears the filter. With SimpleBuilding it can be laid down and pulls items to itself.
simplegadgets.guide.page.1.title: Simple Gadgets
simplegadgets.guide.page.2.title: Simple Gadgets
simplegadgets.guide.page.2: the Gauge - a speed dial, an altimeter that warns of fall damage and auto-walk along paths and rails - the Transposer, which turns and swaps blocks in place, the Resonance Rod, a beam that points, melts, ignites and measures, the Echo
simplegadgets.guide.page.3.title: Simple Gadgets
simplegadgets.guide.page.3: Sounder, which jumps back to a lodestone, the Detector, which points to ores, and the Attractor, which pulls in loose items.
simplegadgets.guide.page.4.title: Gauge
simplegadgets.guide.page.4: The Gauge shows speed while held in either hand, with an animated item needle and a HUD dial.
simplegadgets.guide.page.5.title: Transposer
simplegadgets.guide.page.5: The Transposer is a handy tool for turning orientable blocks right where they are in the world, without breaking and replacing them.
simplegadgets.guide.page.6.title: Transposer
simplegadgets.guide.page.6: It helps above all when building with logs and pillars, with furnaces, pistons or hoppers, and with every block that turns in 16 steps. Where you click on a block face decides how it turns. It never breaks:
simplegadgets.guide.page.7.title: Transposer
simplegadgets.guide.page.7: its durability is a charge that you top up at the anvil with ender pearls. It also puts armor stands into poses.
simplegadgets.guide.page.8.title: Detector
simplegadgets.guide.page.8: The Detector is sonar for mining:
simplegadgets.guide.page.9.title: Detector
simplegadgets.guide.page.9: hold it in your hand and once every 20 ticks it looks for the nearest ore in a sphere around you, turns its amethyst needle toward the find like a compass toward a lodestone, and plays a sound with a faint particle trail from your eyes
simplegadgets.guide.page.10.title: Detector
simplegadgets.guide.page.10: to the ore; which of the twenty ticks that falls on depends on the player, so that the detectors of several players do not all scan in the same tick.
simplegadgets.guide.page.11.title: Detector
simplegadgets.guide.page.11: Six modes decide what it looks for, from iron to ancient debris or any block you calibrate it to yourself.
simplegadgets.guide.page.12.title: Detector
simplegadgets.guide.page.12: Every block between you and the ore damps the ore's signal - soft rock such as netherrack a little, stone more, deepslate and obsidian a lot - and the rarer the ore, the weaker its signal:
simplegadgets.guide.page.13.title: Detector
simplegadgets.guide.page.13: common ores are read through 4 blocks of stone, diamonds through 2, ancient debris only through 2 netherrack. Through open cave air it finds ores 16 to 24 blocks away. Every ping that finds something costs 1 durability;
simplegadgets.guide.page.14.title: Detector
simplegadgets.guide.page.14: empty pings are free. The Radius enchantment roughly doubles how much rock the rare ores get through, Constructor's Touch halves every block's loss.
simplegadgets.guide.page.15.title: Attractor: Collecting Items From a Distance
simplegadgets.guide.page.15: The Attractor pulls loose items while held in either hand. Its base radius around the player hitbox is 4 blocks; sneaking pauses it.
simplegadgets.guide.page.16.title: Readout box
simplegadgets.guide.page.16: A held Gauge shows its readout in a small dark box next to the crosshair: the item's name as the title, a speed dial with the number in blocks per second, and further lines.
simplegadgets.guide.page.17.title: Readout box
simplegadgets.guide.page.17: With SimpleBuilding the box stacks with the Octant's and the Resonance Rod's boxes (Octant on top, then Gauge,
simplegadgets.guide.page.18.title: Readout box
simplegadgets.guide.page.18: then Rod) and follows SimpleBuilding's HUD position, size and HUD key; alone it sits at the left edge in the middle of the screen.
simplegadgets.guide.page.19.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplegadgets.guide.page.19: The Gauge, the Transposer and the Resonance Rod, their recipes and recipe unlocks were SimpleBuilding's (simplebuilding:*).
simplegadgets.guide.page.20.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplegadgets.guide.page.20: Old worlds load them under simplegadgets:* through SimpleLib's id moves and save the new ids - in inventories, chests and on the ground alike.
simplegadgets.guide.page.21.title: Creative tabs
simplegadgets.guide.page.21: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
